summary: Explains how fee receipts are generated after payment, their customizable format, and the display of payment details and remarks.
steps: After a successful fee collection, a confirmation prompt will appear.
Confirm the transaction to generate the receipt.
The system will generate a receipt in a predefined format.
The receipt can be viewed and printed.
business_rules: Receipts are generated automatically upon successful payment.
The receipt format is customizable to fit office requirements.
important_notes: Receipts display payment details, student information, and any remarks entered during the collection process.
The institute's logo can be integrated into the receipt template.
Concession details, if applied, will be clearly shown on the receipt.

There is a discussion point regarding automatically emailing receipts to students due to potential refund/cancellation risks; currently, physical receipts are often collected from the counter for confirmation.
questions: How is a fee receipt generated after payment?
Can the fee receipt format be customized?
Where do remarks entered during fee collection appear on the receipt?
Will the institute's logo be displayed on the receipt?
Do concession details appear on the fee receipt?
Are receipts automatically sent to the student's email?
